faq.question: Can I change plans later?
faq.answer: Yes! You can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. Changes take effect immediately and we'll prorate any charges.

faq.question: Is there a free trial?
faq.answer: Absolutely! Our Pro plan comes with a 14-day free trial. No credit card required to start.

faq.question: How does billing work?
faq.answer: We bill monthly or annually. Annual billing gives you a 20% discount. We accept all major credit cards and PayPal.

faq.question: Can I cancel anytime?
faq.answer: Yes, you can cancel your subscription at any time. Your access will continue until the end of your billing period.
